detailed_description: The URL Encoder/Decoder tool implements RFC 3986-compliant percent-encoding to convert URLs and query strings into valid URI components. This tool leverages JavaScript's encodeURI, encodeURIComponent, and decodeURIComponent functions to handle UTF-8 character transformation, properly escaping reserved characters (; , / ? : @ & = + $ - _ . ! ~ * ' ( ) #) while preserving URI structural integrity. Developers need this for preparing URLs containing special characters like spaces (converted to %20), creating API request endpoints with dynamic parameters, or decoding server-returned percent-encoded responses. The encoder applies hierarchical processing: full URLs maintain scheme/host structure while query parameters undergo component-level encoding. Decoding reverses this process, converting percent sequences back to original byte representations. Unique features include selective encoding scope (full URL vs query string) and automatic character-set detection for internationalized domain names.
usage_steps: Select 'Encode' or 'Decode' from the toggle switch above the input panel
Paste the URL or query string into the syntax-highlighted textarea
Choose processing scope via dropdown: 'Full URL' or 'Query String Only'
Click 'Process' to execute UTF-8 compliant percent-encoding/decoding
Copy results using the clipboard icon adjacent to the output field
Validate encoded URLs with the built-in URI structure parser
usage_examples: Encoding a search query parameter: Convert 'q=blue dress' to 'q=blue%20dress' for a shopping API request
Decoding server logs: Transform '%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82' back to 'тест' Cyrillic text in access logs
API key handling: Safely encode a base64 'Authorization' header parameter containing '+' characters
Bookmarklet creation: Convert JavaScript code in 'javascript:(function(){...})' to URI-safe format

faqs.question: What's the difference between URL encoding and decoding?
faqs.answer: Encoding converts unsafe characters (like spaces or &) into a percent-encoded format (%20). Decoding reverses this process, turning codes back into readable characters.

faqs.question: Does this tool handle full URLs or just query string parameters?
faqs.answer: It handles both complete URLs and individual query string fragments, encoding or decoding the entire input you provide.

faqs.question: What character set does the encoder use?
faqs.answer: It uses UTF-8 encoding by default, following modern web standards to correctly handle international characters.

faqs.question: Is there a limit to the amount of text I can process?
faqs.answer: The tool is designed for practical web use; extremely large inputs may be truncated, but it handles standard URLs and queries with ease.

faqs.question: Is my data secure when using this online tool?
faqs.answer: Yes. All processing happens instantly in your browser. Your URLs are never sent to or stored on our servers.
